cases.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

cases.name: every_known_tag_carries_a_value
cases.why: All four tags non-default at once. The section has to be a single ascending run — 0, 1, 2, 3 — each entry sized by its own payload, which is the claim the whole construct rests on.

cases.name: a_sparse_section_omits_the_defaulted_tags
cases.why: Tags 0 and 2 hold their defaults and must vanish entirely, leaving 1 and 3 adjacent in the run. Omitting a default-valued tag is what makes the section sparse; writing it would inflate every message for no information.

cases.name: a_known_tag_merges_with_a_retained_unknown_one
cases.why: A tag this build knows and a tag it does not, in one section. The retained entry is numerically above every known tag here — the corpus has no message whose known tags start above zero — so the interleave below a known tag is proven by kafka-wire-core's own vectors.
